'''Dor'shan''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. It was also the home of [[Baran Do temple|the temple]] of the [[Baran Do]]. The city contained small and isolated buildings, designs ranged from domes, trapezoids, and ziggurats, all built to withstand the brutal storms. Many colored lights illuminated the city of squat buildings, many engraved with geometric and organic patterns.

The [[Dor'shan spaceport|spaceport]] consisted of several domed docks; all unloading areas were inside, to keep safe those not native to the world from the poisonous gases of the atmosphere.
